title: Residual Accrual-Size Regime Strategy
description: Sector-neutral accrual residualized against size, weighted by inverse-size, VIX/HY regime conditioning. CF-based accrual: (NI-OCF)/TA from DART.

title: BAB Sector-Neutral Regime-Conditioned
description: Frazzini-Pedersen BAB: low-beta long, high-beta short. Shrinkage beta(0.6/0.4), sector-neutral Z, regime scaling.

title: Low-Vol Quality: IdioVol+Beta Composite
description: Z(-IdioVol)*0.4 + Z(-Beta)*0.6, sector-neutral, quality gate, regime scaling. STR_002 monthly (FAIL 37.6), STR_003 quarterly (FAIL 37.3, MDD 45.67% barely over limit).

title: Trended Momentum (PRET × Trend Clarity)
description: Cai et al (2024): Momentum concentrates in stocks with clear price trends. TC = R² of Close~date OLS. Double sort: Tercile(PRET) × Tercile(TC). High TC momentum = 12.68% ann (84% above unconditional). No post-pub decay, crash mitigation.

title: Amihud Illiquidity Premium
description: Amihud (2002): ILLIQ = avg(|Ret|/DollarVol). STR_005: FAIL 60/100, CAGR 21%, Sharpe 1.0, MDD 55.3%. STR_006: ILLIQ+Regime+LowVol 테스트 중.

title: OCAM: Open-to-Close Modified Amihud
description: Barardehi et al (2020): OCAM = avg(|OCR|/DollarVol), OCR=Close/Open-1. 하룻밤 노이즈 제거. CCAM 대비 유동성 프리미엄 50~120% 더 크게 포착. STR_005의 직접 업그레이드.

title: Kyle Invariance Illiquidity Index
description: Kyle & Obizhaeva (2016): 1/L ∝ (sigma²/DVOL)^(1/3). 큐브루트 스케일링, 비즈니스 타임 이론 기반. 아웃라이어 압축. STR_008: FAIL 65.4/100, CAGR 23.2%, Sharpe 1.115, MDD 53.6%. STR_009 (VT15%): FAIL 56.0, MDD 49.4%. STR_010 (LV+Kyle Ensemble): 진행중.
data_required: OHLCVS Close, Vol (+ High, Low for Parkinson sigma)

title: Sloan Accrual Anomaly (CFS Method)
description: Sloan (1996): Investors fixate on earnings, ignoring differential persistence of accruals (lower) vs cash flows (higher). Low accrual (=earnings backed by cash) = LONG. Accrual_CFS = (NI - CFO) / AvgTotalAssets. Hedge earns +10.4% in yr+1. Korean mkt: stronger in KOSDAQ (lower coverage). Signal active April 1 (after March 31 filing). Sector-neutral. Use CFS method for K-IFRS post-2011.

title: Quality Minus Junk (QMJ) Composite
description: Asness, Frazzini, Pedersen (2019): Quality = z(Profitability + Growth + Safety). Profitability = z(GPOA+ROE+ROA+CFOA+GMAR+ACC). Growth = z(5yr-delta of each). Safety = z(-beta+(-lev)+(-Zscore)+(-EarnVol)). Long top-30%, short bottom-30%, size-neutral. 4-factor alpha +105bps/month US, +99bps global (24 countries). Best in crisis environments (flight to quality). Negatively correlated with value/HML — good diversifier vs crowded Korean PBR strategies.
data_required: DART fundamentals (GrossProfit, CFO, TotalAssets, Equity, Debt) + OHLCVS (beta)

title: Macro-Gated LowVol (Buddha Mode Cash-Out)
description: Extension of STR_003 (LowVol, MDD=45.67%, only 0.67%p over limit). Add macro regime gate: when Buddha_Mode=TRUE OR Macro_Risk_Score>=30 OR VIX_Regime=extreme → skip signal date → simulation liquidates to cash. LowVol portfolio re-enters when regime normalizes. Expected: MDD 45.67%→43-44%, CAGR minimal drag (~0.5-1%p). Uses FRED macro_regime.parquet already available.

title: Sloan Accrual CFS Method (Korea Implementation)
description: Sloan (1996): Accrual_CFS = (NI - CFO) / AvgTotalAssets. Low accrual = earnings backed by cash = LONG. Hedge earns +10.4% year+1. Korean adaptation: use CFS method (K-IFRS post-2011), April 1 signal date (after March 31 filing deadline), sector-neutral. fundamental_dart.parquet already has Accrual column.
data_required: DART fundamentals (fundamental_dart.parquet - complete after DART collection)

title: Inventory Change Factor (DeltaInventory)
description: Thomas & Zhang (2002): DeltaInventory/AvgAssets as standalone factor. 11.39% hedge. DeltaRaw Material strongest sub-component. Annual rebal via DART.

title: DNCO Non-Current Operating Accruals
description: Richardson et al. (2005): DNCO = D(non-current operating assets - liabilities) / AvgAssets. 16.3%/yr hedge. Stronger than working capital accruals alone. DART long-term balance sheet items required.

title: Abnormal Accruals Jones Model (ABNAC)
description: Xie (2001): ABNAC = actual accruals minus normal (Jones regression). Only discretionary portion is mispriced. Industry-year regression. Strong for Korea earnings management environment.

title: Size-Accrual Double Sort Portfolio
description: Palmon et al. (2008): Long small-cap low-accrual, avoid large-cap high-accrual. Asymmetric size interaction modifies STR_012 construction only. No new data needed.

title: Asset Growth Factor (AG)
description: AG = (TotalAssets_t - TotalAssets_{t-1}) / TotalAssets_{t-1}. Short high-AG, long low-AG. Korea EW spread 9.2%/yr (t=2.19, Watanabe 2013). Annual rebal from DART. Long-only: exclude top-quintile high-AG stocks as quality gate.

title: Asset Turnover Change Factor (ΔAT)
description: ΔAT = change in (Sales/NOA). Efficiency component of accruals. Coefficient -0.151 (t=-17.06) more predictive than SG. Complement to STR_012 accrual - catches distortion separately from growth accruals.
data_required: DART: Revenue, TotalAssets, TotalLiab (2 consecutive years)

title: Firm Age Universe Filter
description: Exclude stocks listed < 36 months. Beta declines monotonically with firm age (gamma=-0.007/yr, t=-6.16). Young firms have higher estimation risk and beta ~1.7. Age filter reduces high-estimation-risk stocks from universe, improving LowVol/QMJ factor quality.
data_required: KRX listing date (from universe.parquet or DART)

title: Blume-Adjusted Beta in Factor Construction
description: Replace raw OLS beta with Blume-adjusted beta: adj_beta = 0.67 * raw_beta + 0.33 in all beta-based factors. Blume (1975) shows beta mean-reverts toward 1.0; adjusted beta more predictive. One-line change in backtest_harness.

title: Accounting Beta (Fundamental Beta Surrogate)
description: Accounting Beta = Cov(ΔEarnings_i, ΔMarket_Earnings) / Var(ΔMarket_Earnings). 7 fundamental risk proxies (earnings variability, earnings covariability, leverage, liquidity, payout, growth, asset size). R=0.72-0.80 with market beta in Beaver 1970. Forward-looking LowVol surrogate from DART.

title: CoMetric Crowding Overlay for STR_011/STR_013
description: CoMetric = signed avg pairwise residual correlation of LowVol basket members. Computed from RAWDATA price data only. HARD GATE: skip rebalance if CoMetric > 95th pct. SOFT GATE: add 10 stocks (reduce concentration) if CoMetric > 80th pct. Specifically tested on LowVol/low-beta strategies (divergence premium category) in Baltas 2019.

title: Korean Actratio Stock-Level Crowding Screen
description: Korean_Actratio = (외국인비율 + 기관비율) / 60d_ADTV_turnover. Quarterly update from KRX public data + RAWDATA. Exclude top-quintile high-Actratio stocks from LowVol basket. 78-82% next-quarter persistence. Complementary to CoMetric: CoMetric tells WHETHER basket crowded, Actratio tells WHICH stocks are crowded.
data_required: KRX institutional/foreign ownership data + RAWDATA ADTV

name: 3-Year Weekly Volatility Composite for STR_011b
description: Add 3-year (156-week) weekly total return volatility (40% weight) + 1-month IVOL (30%) + 60m Beta (30%). Korea confirmed (Baker/Haugen P131). Reduces turnover 30%, 12% global alpha spread.

name: STR_015 Regime-Adaptive Min-Var (Ledoit-Wolf + constraints)
description: Constrained covariance optimization. Universe: 3yr vol bottom 30%. Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage. beta<0.80, sector +/-10%, max 6% weight, 15% one-way turnover cap. Keep STR_011 macro regime overlay.

name: GP/ME as Primary Korean Quality Signal
description: Asia Pacific large-cap FFC alpha=1.34%/mo for GP/ME. Profitability stronger for large-cap in Asia Pacific (opposite to US). Use GP/ME=gross_profit/market_cap as primary, weight 2x in composite.

name: CFOA-Primary Quality Composite (Sticky Expectations)
description: CFOA most persistent (phi=0.78), largest stickiness-amplified anomaly (1.02%/mo 5-factor alpha). Korean: 영업활동현금흐름/자산총계. Weight CFOA 1.5x vs ROE in quality composite.

name: Stambaugh 9-Factor Composite Mispricing (Korea)
description: Composite rank: ROA, GP, accruals, net stock issues, investment-to-assets, AG, O-score, NOA, momentum. Real investment signals most stable. Expected 25-40 bps/mo gross alpha in Korea. LASSO-confirmed (Feng et al.).

name: Beta Threshold Exclusion + Analytic Weighting
description: 80-90% of min-var risk is systematic beta. Analytic formula: w_i ∝ (1/σ²_ei)×(1-β_i/β_L). Blume shrinkage β_adj=0.5+0.5×β_hist. Expected MDD -2 to -4pp improvement.

name: Korean Anomaly Post-Publication Decay ~0% (No Haircut Needed)
description: International markets: ~0% post-pub decay vs US -60%. Korea: limited short-selling, minimal QA capital. ALL published academic factors fully exploitable without publication decay haircut.

name: Korean HML Value Factor — Pure Value Long-Only Strategy
description: Korean HML = 0.94%/mo (t=2.83, p<0.01), 11.3%/yr, period 1991-2017 KOSPI+KOSDAQ. Strongest of FF3 factors in Korea (RM-RF=0.11% t=0.25 not significant; SMB=0.35% t=0.91 not significant). PBR-based pure value strategy long-only: bottom quintile PBR (book-to-market high), sector-neutral, monthly rebal. Korea legal mandate (NPS, pension mandates PBR disclosure) creates structural persistence.

name: Korean 4-Regime Factor Rotation (Macro Cycle)
description: Export YoY z-score (경기) + CPI YoY z-score (물가) → 4 regimes: Recovery (high export, low CPI), Expansion (high/high), Stagflation (low export, high CPI), Recession (low/low). Each regime has optimal factor weights: Recovery=quality+momentum, Expansion=momentum+growth, Stagflation=low-vol+value, Recession=low-vol+defensive. Use macro_fred.parquet CPI_YoY + need Export data from KOSIS.
data_required: macro_fred.parquet (CPI_YoY exists) + Korea Export YoY (KOSIS API needed)

name: HAA-G4 Korean ETF Asset Allocation
description: Harmonious Asset Allocation (Keller 2022): harmonic mean of 1/3/6/12mo momentum + breadth indicator. 4-asset offensive: KOSPI200, EAFE-proxy (H-shares ETF), EM-proxy, Korean LT bonds. 1-asset defensive: 단기채 (TIGER 미국채1~3년선물). Harmonic mean dampens momentum crashes. SR ~1.25-1.35. Uses backtest_harness monthly simulation.
data_required: Korean ETF price data (RAWDATA already has KOSPI proxy)

name: MDAA Korean Implementation (Rate-Rise Resilient AA)
description: 강봉주 MDAA (2020): 2-asset canary (EM equity + EM bond) + short-duration safety (TIGER 미국채1~3년선물) + 13612W momentum on 16 assets. Canary uses breadth of b=2/2 protection. Proven Korean ETF backtests: 2020 +21%, 2022 gold-standard rate-rise defense. Uses macro_fred.parquet Term_Spread + HY_Spread as canary signals.

name: Quality-Value Combo — Korean HML × GPA Double Sort
description: Korean HML confirmed (t=2.83) + GPA Korea confirmed (Asia Pacific FFC alpha 1.34%/mo). Double sort: low PBR (value) × high GPA (quality). Removes value traps (distressed low-PBR firms) by requiring quality screen. Expected: HML premium with quality filter = 12-15%/yr. DART: BookValue, GrossProfit, TotalAssets, MarketCap.
data_required: DART (BookValue, GrossProfit, TotalAssets) + RAWDATA (Size for MarketCap)

name: Korean Liquidity Crisis Regime Rotator
description: Use aggregate market ILLIQ level as crisis regime detector. When market ILLIQ z-score > 1.5 SD, shift to liquid mega-cap portfolio; when normal, restore factor portfolio. Li-Mooradian-Zhang: 4.68% quarterly return differential per 1SD ILLIQ change. ILLIQ = avg(|Ret|/DollarVol) computed from RAWDATA daily. Expected alpha: +2-3%/yr overlay on any strategy.

name: KOSDAQ Turnover-LM12 Illiquidity Premium
description: KOSDAQ-specific: LM12 (zero-volume days count in 12mo) + annual turnover composite. Structural illiquidity premium in KOSDAQ due to lower coverage, higher retail share. Quality gate: only KOSDAQ stocks with Accrual < median AND GPA > median. Expected alpha: 3-5%/yr vs KOSDAQ benchmark. RAWDATA-only implementation.

name: DuPont ROE-Delta Factor (KB 김민규, P186)
description: KB증권 실증 (2018): ROE 절대 수준보다 DuPont 3요소의 '변화량'이 유효. Score = Δ(순이익률) + Δ(자산회전율) - Δ(재무레버리지). Korean KOSPI backtest: 19.7%/yr absolute, IR=0.84. Better than static ROE level. Use DART 2-year delta of NetMargin, AssetTurnover, Leverage.
data_required: DART (NetIncome, Revenue, TotalAssets, TotalEquity) — 2 consecutive years

name: Mirage Discount: Apply 0.5× to All Backtest Alphas (P166 Insight)
description: P166 Smart Beta Mirage: average alpha decay from backtest to live = 3.22%/yr. Multi-factor: 4.11% pre-listing → -0.79% post-listing (worst case). P158: low-vol backtest alpha = mostly revaluation alpha, not structural. Implement in hurdle_gate.R: discounted_alpha = raw_backtest_CAGR_excess × 0.50. Only count discounted alpha toward hurdle threshold.

name: Carhart 4-Factor as Standard Evaluation Benchmark
description: Carhart (1997): Add PR1YR (12-1 month momentum) to FF3. Explains virtually all mutual fund return persistence. Use Carhart alpha (FF3+MOM) as primary alpha metric in strategy_analyzer instead of raw CAPM alpha. Compute Korean Carhart factors from RAWDATA: MKT, SMB, HML (from DART), MOM (12-1 month price).

name: H-01: Consensus Bottleneck Dispersion
description: Cross-paper: Salience Theory (Bordalo 2012) x Consensus-Bottleneck APM (POSTECH 2025). Signal: z(analyst_target_price_dispersion) * z(-attention_proxy). Long stocks with HIGH analyst disagreement but LOW retail attention = hidden information asymmetry. Sector-neutral, monthly rebal.

name: H-02: Transfer Entropy Flow Networks
description: Cross-paper: Kyle Invariance (1985/2016) x Analyst Network Alpha (2024). Signal: TEFlow_i = sum(TE(j->i)) - sum(TE(i->j)) over rolling 63d. Long NET INFORMATION RECEIVERS = stocks absorbing information slowly. Biweekly rebal. RAWDATA only.
data_required: RAWDATA daily returns only (top 500 liquid stocks)

name: H-05: Intangible Capital Mispricing via R&D Persistence
description: Cross-paper: Richardson Accrual Decomposition (2005) x Alpha Architect Intangible Investment (2026). Signal: z(R&D_intensity_3yr_avg) * z(-book_to_market). Long HIGH R&D + LOW PBR = intangible capital not on balance sheet. R&D/Rev must be increasing 3yr (persistence filter). Annual rebal.

name: H-09: Herding-Contrarian Asymmetry (HCA)
description: Cross-paper: Asch Herding (1955) x Alpha Architect Defensive Strategies 2 Centuries (2026). Signal: z(-corr(stock_ret, sector_avg_ret, 63d)) * z(foreign_ownership_change_3m). Long stocks DECORRELATED from sector AND with INCREASING foreign ownership = smart money against the herd.

name: H-10: Variance Ratio Information Speed
description: Cross-paper: Lo & MacKinlay Variance Ratio x Beyond Volatility: Idiosyncratic Quantile Risks (2022). Signal: z(VR(5d/1d) - VR(20d/5d)). Long stocks trending at daily level but mean-reverting at weekly = fast news incorporation + slow fundamental adjustment. RAWDATA only, computationally trivial.

name: H-12: Stock-Level Drift Regime Gating (Value+Reversal)
description: Singha (2025): Stock-specific drift regimes unlock cross-sectional predictability. Signal: drift_flag = (positive_days_63d / 63 > 0.60). When flag=TRUE, apply z(BM) + z(-ret_5d) value+reversal score. When flag=FALSE, exclude stock entirely. OOS Sharpe >13 on S&P500 (2004-2024). Key innovation: STOCK-LEVEL regime conditioning, not market-level. Trivially computable from RAWDATA.
data_required: RAWDATA daily returns only (+ DART BookValue for BM ratio)

name: H-13: Korea Value-Up Governance Alpha
description: Song & Chun (2025): Korea Value-Up program + Commercial Act amendments (Jul 2025) create structural governance alpha. KVI outperformed KOSPI200 by 30%+. Signal: ValueUp_Score = z(div_payout_change_YoY) + z(ROE_delta) + z(treasury_cancel_flag) + z(foreign_own_change). Long top-quintile Value-Up improvers. Time-sensitive structural alpha specific to Korea 2025-2026.
data_required: DART fundamentals (dividends, ROE, treasury shares) + KRX ownership data

name: H-14: IC-Momentum Factor Weighting
description: Dynamic weighting of factor scores by trailing 63d Information Coefficient (IC). Replace fixed weights (e.g., IVOL 0.4 / Beta 0.6) with IC-momentum weights. Each factor's weight proportional to its recent cross-sectional predictive power. Ensemble Sharpe exceeds weighted average of constituents. Generalizable to ANY multi-factor composite.
data_required: RAWDATA only (computes IC from existing factor scores and forward returns)

name: H-15: Factor-Efficacy Endogenous Regimes
description: Define regimes by WHICH FACTORS WORK (trailing 63d factor IC), not by macro indicators. In 'IVOL works' regime: overweight Defense. In 'Momentum works' regime: overweight IndMom. Endogenous regime avoids macro data lag. Key: use 1-month lag between formation and holding to avoid circularity. Explainable regime definitions.

name: H-16: Pure IVOL Defense (No Beta Component)
description: Blitz, Howard, Huang, Jansen (Robeco, 2025): Low-risk alpha can be captured WITHOUT loading on low-beta stocks. IVOL is the PRIMARY driver; Beta component adds noise. Test Defense score = z(IdioVol)*1.0 (no Beta) vs current z(IdioVol)*0.4 + z(Beta)*0.6. One-line change in factor_engine. If confirmed: simpler, possibly higher Sharpe.
expected_orthogonality: Refinement of Defense, not new alpha source
